items.title: Kyle McCord: New starting QB in Miami
items.description:
McCord will step in as the Dolphins' starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game at Indianapolis after Miami placed Malik Willis (core) on injured reserve Tuesday, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
